arabic text: MERE SAR PE RIDA KOI NAHI, BAZAAR E JAFA\nMAJMA HAI KOOFIYO KA MERE CHALNE KI JAA KOI NAI
english translation text: Sajjad, I am Zainab. There is no chadar upon my head in this marketplace\nof oppression. A crowd of Kufans blocks every place for me to walk.

arabic text: SAJJAD MERE SAR SE NAU BAAR CHINI CHADAR\nBALWE MAY NABI ZADI PHIRWAYI GAYI DARR DARR\nMILJAYE RIDA MUJKO AUR MERI DUA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: Sajjad, the chadar was snatched from my head nine times.\nThe Prophet's granddaughter was paraded from door to door in the riot.\nMay I receive a veil—and there is no one to accept my prayer.

arabic text: SAJJAD MERE DIL KO YE DARD SATA-TA HAI\nSAR GHAZI KA NAIZE SE JAB KHAAKH PE AATA HAI\nSAR MERE KHULA DEKH KE GHAM ISSAY BADA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: Sajjad, this pain torments my heart:\nwhen Ghazi's head falls from the spear onto the dust,\nseeing my uncovered head, no grief is greater than his.

arabic text: SAJJAD CHALOON KAISE LAKHON HAI TAMASHAYI\nYAAD AATA REH REH KE ABBAS MERA BHAI\nFARYAD KAROON TUJHSE AB TERE SIWA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: Sajjad, how can I walk when millions stand watching?\nAgain and again I remember my brother Abbas.\nNow I can appeal only to you; none remains besides you.

arabic text: MALOOM HAI AADA KO GHAZI KI BAHAN MAI\nBE-DAST HAI WO GHAZI PABANDE RASAN HOO MAI\nYAAD AAYI WAFA USKI JAB PAAS RAHA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: The enemies know I am Ghazi's sister.\nThat Ghazi is without hands, while I am bound in rope.\nI remembered his loyalty when no one remained beside me.

arabic text: SAJJAD TERI HAALAT DEKHI NAHI JATI HAI\nBE-PARDA MUJHE DEKHE YE BAAT RULATI HAI\nSAJJAD TERI TARHA KANTON PE CHAL KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: Sajjad, I cannot bear to see your condition.\nIt makes me weep that you see me without a veil.\nLike you, no one else walks upon thorns.

arabic text:
JAATA HAI SUYE ZINDAN AB KUNBA MOHAMED KA
RASSI MAY BANDHE QAIDI KANTON SE BHARA RASTA
UMMAT NE SITAM DHAYE KISMAT SE GILA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
SAJJAD MAI ZAINAB....
english translation text:
Muhammad's household now journeys towards prison.
Captives bound in rope walk a road filled with thorns.
The nation committed oppression, yet we do not complain against destiny.
Sajjad, I am Zainab.

arabic text: MAUT AAYEGI ZINDAN MAY MERI BALI SAKINA KO\nKYA JAKE BATUNGI BEMAARE MADINA KO\nGHAM DIL KE UTHANE KO AB BAKHI BACHA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: Little Sakina will die within the prison.\nWhat will I tell the ailing one of Madina?\nNo one remains to help me carry the grief within my heart.

arabic text: BAZARE SITAM MAY THA ZAINAB KA AJAB AALMA\nMAZHAR MAI LIKHOO KAISE ZALIM NE KAHA JIS DAM\nHAI KAUN TERA WARIS ZAINAB NE KAHA KOI NAI BAZARE JAFA
english translation text: O Mazhar, what a state Zainab endured in the marketplace of cruelty.\nHow can I write what the tyrant said:\n'Who is your heir?' Zainab replied: no one.
